prompt: Why is Cedar unsuitable even though it has the longest listed usable length?
promptZh: Cedar 公布的可用長度最長，為何仍不能選？

options.text: It is too narrow once both margins are included.
options.zh: 加上兩側餘量後，它不夠寬。
options.whyZh: Cedar 寬五十八公分，只等於展板本身的寬度，還缺兩公分。

options.text: Its usable length is less than 12 metres.
options.zh: 它的可用長度不足十二公尺。
options.whyZh: 表格列十六公尺，已足夠長。

options.zh: 它公布的長度包含受損區段。
options.whyZh: 工單說表中可用長度已扣除受損區段。

explanationZh: Cedar 寬五十八公分，只等於展板本身的寬度，還缺兩公分。
evidence: The lobby panel is 58 cm wide. Its two edges require one extra centimetre of film on each side, so the roll width must allow for both margins. / Cedar | 58 | 16 | removable

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: The lobby panel is 58 cm wide. Its two edges require one extra centimetre of film on each side, so the roll width must allow for both margins.

vocabulary.note: 此處指展板每一側都要多留的寬度。
